plugin_desc: Dataprobe iBoot-PDU SNMP child template for devices under Dataprobe PEN 1418. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. Proven private increments under 1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6 are voltageLC1/currentLC1 (and optional LC2) scaled by /100 as snmp_pdu_line*_voltage_volts and snmp_pdu_line*_current_amps, plus temperature1/temperature2 as Celsius after dropping the 999 no-probe sentinel. Fahrenheit unit readings are converted to Celsius. Single-line-cord models omit line 2 when voltageLC2 is 0 or absent. CPU, memory, fan and PSU scalars are not invented. Outlet switch tables are not collected in this pass. Supported brands/models - Dataprobe iBoot-PDU devices that expose the iBoot-PDU-Agent sensor scalars and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: snmp_pdu_line1_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Line-cord 1 voltage in volts from voltageLC1 (1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6.6.1.0). The SNMP value is hundredths of a volt and is scaled by /100. Absent values are not reported.

metrics.name: snmp_pdu_line1_current_amps
metrics.description: Line-cord 1 current in amperes from currentLC1 (1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6.6.2.0). The SNMP value is hundredths of an amp and is scaled by /100. Absent values are not reported.

metrics.name: snmp_pdu_line2_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Optional line-cord 2 voltage in volts from voltageLC2 (1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6.6.3.0). The SNMP value is hundredths of a volt and is scaled by /100. Line 2 is dropped when the voltage is 0 or absent on single-line-cord models.

metrics.name: snmp_pdu_line2_current_amps
metrics.description: Optional line-cord 2 current in amperes from currentLC2 (1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6.6.4.0). The SNMP value is hundredths of an amp and is scaled by /100. Line 2 is dropped when voltageLC2 is 0 or absent.

metrics.name: snmp_env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Probe 1 temperature in degrees Celsius from temperature1 (1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6.6.5.0). The 999 no-probe sentinel is dropped. Fahrenheit unit readings are converted to Celsius. Persistently high values may indicate cooling or ambient-temperature risk.

metrics.name: snmp_env_temperature_2_celsius
metrics.description: Optional probe 2 temperature in degrees Celsius from temperature2 (1.3.6.1.4.1.1418.6.6.6.0). The 999 no-probe sentinel is dropped. Fahrenheit unit readings are converted to Celsius.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
